chunks: Regarding a bondwoman belonging to a man, with whom he used to have relations, and she miscarried a fetus from him after three months, he said: "She is an Umm Walad."

key_terms.أُمُّ وَلَدٍ: a bondwoman who has borne or conceived her master's child, acquiring a specific legal status

ai.seo_question: When is a bondwoman considered Umm Walad in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman who conceived from her master and then miscarried after three months. The Imam عليه السلام rules that she is considered Umm Walad, establishing her legal status based on that pregnancy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4567 - Imam (as) said regarding a bondwoman who belonged to a man and with whom he had relations, and she miscarried his child after three months:
"She is considered Umm Walad (the mother of his child)."
